notes.title: Smile For Me Definitive Steam Update!
notes.notes:
While preorders are open for Smile For Me on Consoles, players on Steam receive a FREE UPDATE TODAY!

The Bloom Update is the definitive version of Smile For Me, in partnership with publisher Serenity Forge.

Graphics have been updated, visuals improved, and in-game music has gotten a mouthwatering remaster! Smile For Me has never looked or sounded so tasty.
Controller support, new settings, and stability improvements make the game easier than ever to play.
Returning players also should keep an eye out for brand new art and easter eggs, hidden all around the Habitat. What will you discover?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753427/0e15de3e285249f18790ff983f141fe4260e17b2.png

THAT’S NOT ALL! The game’s DLC has gotten a big upgrade!
The Smile For Me Digital Soundtrack has been fully remastered, with 21 gorgeous music tracks - including Louie Zong’s delicious track from our brand new trailer!
The Smile For Me Digital Artbook also has oodles of new content, totaling over 100 pages. Never-before-seen concept art and commentary by developers Yugo Limbo and Day Lane provide insight into how this weird world was brought to life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753427/421cdf7efeed804e6a71e4b93bbe737f7ee7a016.png

When Smile For Me releases on consoles in Spring 2023, Steam users can look forward to new languages on PC! Smile For Me will be playable in French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.

There’s tons to sink your teeth into. So bare your fangs, dust off your bouquet, and join your friends at The Habitat!



The Bloom Update is live now on Steam for Windows and MacOS.



We’ll be making updates and bugfixes as necessary in the coming weeks.
Contact support@serenityforge.com to report any update-related bugs or issues.

notes.title: New Patch - 2020.10.20
notes.notes:
A small patch today fixes the largest game breaking bug in the game.
Hopefully this increases stability!

Changelist:
-If the game crashes while saving over your file, the original save file is not corrupted
-Corrupted save files no longer prevent the game from loading

notes.title: New Patch - 2019.06.27
notes.notes:
Hi All,
Just a small patch today to repair two issues that were reported to us.
Thanks for sticking with us and reporting issues!

Enjoy!

Changelist:
-Prevents progress loss after losing the second Whack-A-Molar game
-Increases texture legibility on low graphics settings

notes.title: New Patch - 2019.06.14
notes.notes:
Hi all,
Thanks so much for sticking with us for the first 2 weeks of Smile For Me! The community has been amazing, and I hope it will continue to grow! Today's patch fixes a few non-critical bugs and makes some small adjustments. 

Due to popular demand, we've included an album cover in the soundtrack DLC for your collection! Enjoy!

Changelist:
-Adds album cover image to the soundtrack DLC
-Prevents the [spoiler]Lounge Door[/spoiler] from opening on the final day, sequence-breaking the game
-(Hopefully) fixes bug causing Putunia to consume the [spoiler]cape[/spoiler] item, softlocking the game
-Fixes exploit in the [spoiler]tower[/spoiler] that allows out-of-bounds movement
-Fixes typo in the start menu
-Minor visual improvements

notes.title: New Patch - 2019.06.05
notes.notes:
Our second patch! This one has more quality of life changes and fixes some minor bugs. Thanks for sticking with us and continuing to communicate any issues with the game!

  Changelist: 
-Nat is less prone to sniff forever
-(Hopefully) allows nodding to Dallas after giving him a [spoiler]kiss[/spoiler]
-The Autosave file doesn’t update its timestamp when starting a new file
-Makes the indicator for skipping PSAs more obvious when the spacebar is held

-MAJOR FINALE SPOILER: When you are [spoiler]stuck to the chair[/spoiler] in the [spoiler]tower[/spoiler], allows [spoiler]Dr. Habit[/spoiler]’s dialogue to be fast-forwarded
-MAJOR FINALE SPOILER: When [spoiler]Habit[/spoiler] sends you back to the [spoiler]chair[/spoiler], you do not need to redo the [spoiler]button[/spoiler] puzzle

notes.title: Hotfix released
notes.notes:
Hi All!

We've released a new hotfix to address a major bug with saved items. Some save files created since June 3rd have failed to save all of their items. This update should address and repair that bug. In the meantime, it is possible that in the last day and a half, a user might have ended up with a save file that is missing crucial items. We're very sorry if this happened to you, and please feel free to reach out to our support email if you think you're missing items or have questions about whether your save file is softlocked.

This is a precursor to a larger quality of life update which we will roll out tonight or early tomorrow.

Thanks for sticking with us, and sorry about any inconvenience.

Sincerely,
-LL

notes.title: New Patch - 2019.06.03
notes.notes:
We’ve released the first patch for Smile For Me! Thanks for reporting bugs and helping us improve the game. We’re currently tracking more potential bugs, so keep support emails coming! 

Changelist:
-(Hopefully) fixes bug making it impossible to use the [spoiler]toothbrush[/spoiler] on Kamal. Please use the support link to send an email with details if this issue persists after updating your game.
-Starting a new game now backs up the existing Autosave first, to prevent accidentally overwriting progress
-Updates recipe sprite to say “3” mushrooms
-Wallus now reacts to the Photo of Tim Tam
-Fixes Kamal’s clue to the location of the [spoiler]toothbrush[/spoiler]
-Edits the “7” and “1” on [spoiler]Habit’s[/spoiler] wall to be more easily distinguishable
-Updates Gillis’s photo to show his full name
